name: Audio
summary: Every sound in the game, made in code (no sound files): engines that follow each car's revs and throttle, tyre squeal, grass rumble, crashes and contacts, start lights, menu clicks (short switch clicks, not beeps) and the intro screen's GT3 pass-by (Sound.passby()).
notes: Only listens: reads car state and race events, never changes the race. Sounds are synthesised once at start-up by SoundBank. Engine pitch = firing frequency (rpm / 60 * cylinders / 2). Better recorded samples can replace SoundBank's loops later without touching anything else. Menu sounds live in menu_sounds.gd; a recorded file in samples/ (same name, .wav or .ogg) replaces the synthesised one.
